notes: Summary: Thermion runs a cloud-native contact center platform used by telco and retail CX teams. They're building an 'agents-as-a-service' layer: combine fast agent-assist, automated ticket summarization, and backend tool-calling (CRM updates, escalation runbooks).
Key asks: high citation accuracy for KB answers (RAG), automatic source attribution in agent UI, freshness windows for policy docs, and deterministic fallbacks when vector index stale.

Performance targets: p95 query latency < 300ms for agent-assist, batch reranking throughput 150 reqs/sec, and graceful degradation under peak spikes (target: 5k concurrent sessions sustained for 1 minute).

Data sources: Confluence knowledge base (multi-space), Salesforce case threads, S3 archival of past tickets (10M records), and external vendor KBs. Need multi-source dense + sparse retrieval and citation chaining.
Security notes: must support SSO/SAML, per-tenant KMS keys, audit logs retained 2+ years, and EU data residency for EU accounts. Legal flagged HSM requirement for some regulated clients.

Quote from CTO (call 2026-03-02): 'We need citations at the sentence level and an audit trail — agents must see where the answer came from. If a model hallucinates, we need fast fallback to a deterministic search.'

POC scope agreed: 3-week technical POC. Week1: ingest Confluence + SFDC + S3 into a test RAG index. Week2: integrate agent UI plugin and tool-calling demo (create/update case in SFDC). Week3: run spike/reliability tests and cost profiling. Deliverable: ops playbook + recommended quantization/profile for cost targets.
Risk/Concerns logged: current vector store has stale embeddings; onboarding latency on initial indexing is high; internal infra wants private control plane for key management and network isolation.

Sales notes: procurement prefers Dedicated or Private, not hosted API, because of long-term customer SLAs and predictable unit economics. Upside: potential multi-year reserved capacity deal if POC passes.
Action items assigned: SE (Laura) to produce connector spec and ingestion script; Infra lead (Alex M.) to validate VPC-peering; Legal to review KMS/HSM clause by 2026-03-16.
Stubs/Refs: fireflies ff_2026-03-02_thermion-demo (call recording), Drive proposal v1 (pricing), Jira INF-8421 tracker for indexing bug.
